intro: Requests that wait for your yes, your own requests and recent decisions. In this release: quote approvals.

bulk.approveBody: Each is checked again when it is decided: one that changed since it was asked is left waiting and said.
bulk.approvedPartly: {done} approved; {failed} not (changed since asked or not yours): the queue was read again.

waiting.title: Nothing waits for your yes.
waiting.body: When a quote breaks a rule and someone asks, it appears here.

mine.title: You have no open requests.
mine.body: Requests you ask from a quote appear here until someone decides.

decided.title: Nothing decided in the last 7 days.
decided.body: Decisions you made, and decisions on your requests, appear here.

held.OWN_REQUEST: You asked for this: another approver decides.
held.NO_RIGHT: Your role does not approve quotes.
held.NEEDS_MARGIN: About the margin: an approver who sees margins decides.
held.changed: Changed since asked: open the quote and ask again.

review.title: Approve quote {number}?
review.not_found: This request is not in this view any more: it may have been decided or withdrawn.
review.forbidden: You may not open this quote.
review.changed: Changed since asked: the quote is no longer the one asked about.
review.noRule: No rule is broken now: the request may be out of date.
review.noMargin: Margin figures are not shown for your role.

rule.MARGIN_FLOOR: The margin is under the floor.
rule.DISCOUNT_LIMIT: A discount is over the {limit} limit.
rule.AMOUNT_LIMIT: The amount is over the limit.

rejectDialog.title: Reject — tell {who} why
rejectDialog.body: The quote goes back to Draft; your reason lands in its history for the person who asked.

notice.approved: {number} approved. The next request is open.
notice.forbidden: Not decided: you may not decide this request (your own, or a margin request without margin rights).

words.label: Words the customer reads
words.hint: Needed to refuse; optional when you accept. Never an office note.
words.hintBatch: The same words on every order: needed to refuse all, optional when you accept all.
words.none: No words yet: the customer reads only the answer.

held.waitsOnCustomer: Our counter-offer waits for the customer’s answer: they answer it first.

team.sales: Sales answers changes, cancels and ship what is ready.
team.production: The production manager or the planner answers urgent asks, pauses and resumes.
team.other: Another team answers this kind of request.

held.counterLapsed: Our counter-offer lapsed: refuse the request with words; it cannot be accepted without the customer’s yes.
held.counterAgreed: The customer said yes to our counter-offer: accept the request to carry it out.
held.noCounterResume: A resume is accepted or refused: the pause is the customer’s to end.
held.counteredOnce: A request is countered once: answer it now.
held.words: Write the words the customer reads first.
held.noneWaiting: None of these requests waits for an answer.
held.noneCurrent: None of them can be answered so now: see why under each.

counter.title: Suggest something else · {order}
counter.body: The customer answers it in their portal: yes carries the request out with what you offer, no withdraws it. Give a date, a fee, words — at least one.
counter.feeHint: In the order’s currency; 0 says it is free. Only the customer’s buyer sees the amount.
counter.noFee: A fee is set only by someone who sees prices.

held.empty: Give a date, a fee or words first.
held.past: The date is in the past: from today on.
held.fee: The fee is not an amount: write it like 25 or 12,50.

review.title: {kind} · {order}
review.notFound: This request is not there any more.
review.forbidden: This request is outside your rights.
review.batchLine: Asked together with other orders: {count} in all, {waiting} still waiting.

impact.blocked: Some part asked cannot change any more: refuse it, or suggest something else.
impact.notRead: The impact could not be read now: the request shows what the customer saw when asking.

does.title: What accepting does
does.urgent: Accept as urgent: the order becomes Urgent at the end of the customer’s own urgent list; it moves only among that customer’s own orders.
does.rushFloor: Accept and rush the floor: the same, and its work orders go first on every tablet.

team.sales: Sales answers it (changes, cancels, ship what is ready).
team.production: The production manager or the planner answers it (urgent asks, pauses, resumes).

workOrders.title: The order’s work orders
workOrders.notShown: Other work orders of the order you do not reach: {count}

held.lift: Lifting a customer’s pause needs the right to hold work orders.
held.clearRush: Clearing a rush needs the right to manage work orders.

lift.title: Lift the customer’s pause
lift.body: The pause this request placed is lifted on {orders}. A work order still held by another hold stays held.
lift.reasonHint: One line, for the office: the customer sees the work going on.

held.long: One line of at most 500 characters.

batch.title: {kind} · {count} orders
batch.acceptAllRush: Accept all {count} and rush the floor
batch.asked: {customer} asked this of {count} orders at once: {kind}
batch.recheck: Accept all and Refuse all read the batch again first: each request is checked, the current ones are answered one by one.
batch.ack: Each is answered with its own checks; one that moved meanwhile is left as it is and said.

refusal.NO_WORK: The order has no open work order yet: nothing to pause. Refuse with words, or accept once its work orders are made.
refusal.MIXED: A work order of the order was made before the one-customer rule and makes other customers’ pieces too: answer by hand.
refusal.SHARED: A work order of the order also makes another order: a pause would stop that one too. Answer by hand.
refusal.NOTHING_TO_RUSH: No work order of the order can be rushed now: accept it as urgent instead.
refusal.NO_LINE: The sample round asked names no line of the order any more: refuse it with words.
refusal.SALES_ASK: Sales accepts this kind of request.
refusal.PRODUCTION_ASK: Production answers this kind of request here.
refusal.RESUME: A resume is accepted or refused: the pause is the customer’s to end.
refusal.COUNTER_WAITING: Our counter-offer waits for the customer’s answer.
refusal.COUNTER_AGREED: The customer said yes to our counter-offer: accept the request to carry it out.
refusal.COUNTER_REFUSED: The customer said no to our counter-offer: the request is withdrawn.
refusal.COUNTER_LAPSED: Our counter-offer lapsed: refuse the request with words.
refusal.COLOUR_IN_WORK: A work order makes the line in its colour now: answer the colour change by hand (cancel and remake).
refusal.ADDRESS_GONE: The delivery address asked is no longer in use: refuse, or ask the customer for another address.
refusal.SHIPMENT_PREPARED: A shipment is being prepared for the order’s address: change it there first, or refuse.
refusal.NOT_KEPT: The customer’s production record is not there yet: try again in a moment.
refusal.NOT_OPEN: The order is not in production any more.
refusal.URGENCY_OFF: The customer’s urgent orders are switched off: switch them on in their limits card, or refuse.
refusal.LOCKED: We locked this order at Regular: unlock it on the work order first, or refuse.
refusal.other: It was refused as it stands: open the order to see why.
refusal.moved: It changed since you read it: it was read again.
refusal.gone: This request is not there any more.

problem.forbidden: You may not answer this kind of request.
problem.invalid: It was refused as it is: check what you wrote.
problem.unavailable: The server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.rate_limited: Too many tries: wait a moment.
problem.signed_out: Your session ended: sign in again.
